classes.title: AI Studio work could not reach the fleet without a human export step
classes.root_cause: Capture depended on the founder clicking Save to GitHub or downloading a zip, then a manual lane trigger; the turn itself was never an event the estate could observe.
classes.fix: Channel 1 tees the AI Studio stream in the browser (ops/aistudio/genesis-mycelium.user.js); channel 2 accepts Google Drive changes.watch pushes at the edge (platform/lifeboat/src/aistudio.js, /api/ingest/drive-webhook). Both resolve to one (path, sha256)-keyed commit on lane/aistudio-auto-intake, post OMNIFLOW-EVENT/v1 to idp#8133, broadcast chronicle.aistudio_ready and dispatch greenlane.yml.
classes.law: AGENTS.md section 9.3 (one class, one claim, one sweep) and 9.7 (a gate that cannot fail is not a gate)
